method: Resolve each official repository's main ref once, then read the listed files at that immutable commit through the GitHub connector. Preserve repository commit and content blob identities; record only documented mechanisms and their limits. This manifest contains no measured competitor result.
existing_experiment_note: The v0.6.0 supplied-page experiment, six external components, scores, failure records, protocol and dependency locks were not changed by this feature review.

projects.name: OpenViking
projects.license_observation: AGPLv3 in the pinned repository LICENSE; distinct commercial deployment offerings are described separately.
verified_features: Virtual filesystem with directory-level L0/L1 sidecars and full L2 source content.
Target URI, level, permissions and metadata constrain global vector recall; the current retrieval document explicitly excludes recursive directory traversal.
Account/user namespaces and optional shared-resource ACLs are documented.
limits: No runtime retrieval, isolation, quality, latency or resource benchmark executed in this review.
Availability of L0/L1 depends on processing state; model requirements differ for summaries, vector retrieval and optional intent analysis.

projects.name: Serena
projects.license_observation: Serena application GPL-3.0-or-later; SolidLSP MIT, as distinguished by the pinned LICENSE.
verified_features: Project Markdown memories live in .serena/memories; global memories are deliberately shared.
Agents first see memory names; topic directories and mem: references guide detailed reads.
Memory renames update eligible references; a CLI integrity check reports unresolved references.
limits: No runtime isolation or retrieval measurement executed.
Project and global memory are composable; the documented scopes do not by themselves show the behavior of a particular client deployment.

projects.name: EverOS (formerly EverMemOS)
projects.license_observation: Apache-2.0 in the pinned repository LICENSE.
verified_features: Readable Markdown is canonical storage with SQLite and LanceDB indexes.
Memory paths are partitioned by app_id/project_id before user-visible directories; user, agent and session fields also support retrieval.
The normal live ingestion quickstart configures an extraction model; optional providers enable additional retrieval and processing capabilities.
limits: No runtime comparison executed; historical EverMemOS scores and architecture are not assigned to the current implementation.
The no-key standalone demo is an educational path, distinct from the live ingestion service.

projects.name: SimpleMem
projects.license_observation: MIT in the pinned repository LICENSE.
verified_features: Text MCP documents model extraction into atomic facts, hybrid retrieval and LanceDB.
The MCP service documents per-user tables and bearer-token authentication.
Python research paths include capabilities not yet exposed by the text MCP service.
limits: Per-user separation is not independent evidence of separate project boundaries for one user.
Python, multimodal/evolution and text MCP capabilities must be compared using their exact entry points.

projects.name: Supermemory
projects.license_observation: MIT in the pinned repository LICENSE; this observation does not license separately hosted services.
verified_features: Projects/container tags scope memory and profile queries.
The official README documents hosted and local runtimes with extraction, profiles, documents and hybrid retrieval.
Offline text memory is documented with Ollama and local embeddings after setup; URL ingestion uses a hosted reader.
limits: No runtime retrieval, isolation, performance or completeness measurement executed.
The source review does not establish parity between every local and hosted feature.

projects.name: LangMem (supplement to LangGraph ecosystem)
projects.license_observation: MIT in the pinned repository LICENSE.
verified_features: Model-based extraction and management tools integrate with namespaced LangGraph stores.
The README distinguishes process-local InMemoryStore from persistent database-backed storage.
limits: No LangMem pipeline was executed by the existing LangGraph store experiment.
Not counted as an additional project family or independently measured backend.
